title: ECA/TeleCheck® Data Segment
applicability: Conditional member of the ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Request's Data Section 3; exclusive to that message family (not a Financial Transaction Request companion).
scopeNote: Full-catalog baseline: mirrors all 18 rules in docs/specs/kb/segment-113/coverage/segment-113-rule-catalog.json (structure, applicability, field, serialization, compatibility, lifecycle, and metadata classes).

businessRequirements.title: Segment 113 belongs exclusively to the ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Request; it is not a Financial Transaction Request companion
Segment 113 is a conditional member of the ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Request's Data Section 3
Segment Length is 3 digits representing the segment content length
Segment 113 maximum length is 156 alphanumeric characters
Field order matches Section 12.12 ascending element order
All fields are separated by Field Separators; empty fields still send the separator
ECA/TeleCheck Clerk ID, required, is alphanumeric with maximum length 6
ECA/TeleCheck Product Code, when populated, is alphanumeric max 6, no documented enumeration
ECA/TeleCheck Phone Number, when populated, is numeric max 10
ECA/TeleCheck Trace ID, when populated, is alphanumeric max 22; required on Void requests
Merchant Trace ID, when populated, is alphanumeric max 25
Denial Record Number, when populated, is alphanumeric max 7
Extended MICR Data, when populated, is alphanumeric max 65; supplements Segment 110's MICR Data when raw MICR exceeds 50 bytes
Segment 113 appears at most once per message
Segment 113's companions are Segment 110 (required) and Segment 111 (optional)
Segment 113 does not appear in the ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Response

testCases.positive: ECA/TeleCheck Data Segment present at most once, with Standard Segment sibling
Fields serialized in ascending element order with trailing separators
All optional alphanumeric/numeric fields within documented length bounds
negative: Each field individually exceeds its documented max length or format

testCases.positive: Trace ID populated on Void requests
negative: Void request missing Trace ID (business condition, catalog only)

testCases.positive: Extended MICR Data populated alongside Segment 110's MICR Data when raw MICR > 50 bytes
Segment 113 combined only with Segment 100, 110, and optionally 111
negative: Segment 113 combined with a Financial Transaction Request companion (101/102/103/104/108)

testCases.positive: Segment 113 absent from ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Response

testDataStatus: Structure, identity/length, field-bound rules, and response-absence are covered by the synthetic lifecycle fixtures (eca-check-purchase-original, ecatelecheck-void-with-trace-id, ecatelecheck-denial-record-decline) and the rejection fixture (duplicate-occurrence), all exercised by Segment113PayloadValidator and its 10-mutation suite (target 100% detection). Serialization/compatibility/metadata/cross-segment rules are cataloged but not code-enforced per SME direction.
